Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Riaz Hassan will open the batting for Afghanistan. Shoriful Islam will begin with the new ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

The target is not a big one but the visitors' batting has not been at its best. They though still back themselves to chase this down. Bangladesh on the other hand, need wickets and quickly if they are to have any chance of defending this. Will Afghanistan remain win-less? We'll find out in a short while.

Rashid Khan is down for a chat. He says he feels amazing to be someone from Afghanistan to be number third and quickest to 150 ODI wickets. Mentions that he never had it in mind to reach there but he is happy and proud. States that it was all about the lengths that they were bowling in and they had to be consistent with it. Adds that he wanted to be more patient and not to worry about taking wickets. Says that they bowled much better today and it is a good wicket to bat on. Also that he is working on different variations.

Afghanistan were really good with the ball! The key was they were patient, they bowled well early on but with not a lot of success. They did not let the runs flow too. The rewards were reaped by the spinners as Nabi and Rashid were brilliant in the middle overs. The two combined finished with figures of 20-0-66-5 and changed the course of the game. However, they were well supported by the others too and the visitors will be pleased with how things stand at the moment.

The start though was not the best for them as the Bangladesh top three added 104 runs with Das being the mainstay. Once Shakib fell though it was a procession. They kept losing wickets at regular intervals. Mahmudullah held fort at one end but he kept losing partners and in the end the hosts have been bowled out for a low total.
End of an exceptional performance with the ball by Afghanistan and they have surely put themselves into a position to bag their first win of the series and 10 crucial points.

OUT! RUN OUT! That is the third run out of the innings! Afghanistan have bundled out Bangladesh under 200! A length ball, around off. Mahmudullah was cramped for room there and ends up tapping it just towards point. Mahmudullah runs across to the other end to sneak in a single. Rahmanullah Gurbaz runs forward, collects the ball and throws it directly at the striker's end. Mustafizur Rahman is short of his ground. Bangladesh are bundled out for 192!
Another direct hit and Mustafizur Rahman seems short. Afghanistan are already walking off.
A fuller ball, slower one again, outside off. Mahmudullah lifts it wide of long off the fielder runs across and collects it on the bounce.
Length ball, on middle. Mahmudullah blocks it out.
Slower one now, outside off, on a length. Mustafizur Rahman taps it towards point for a quick single. T
A yorker-length delivery, on middle. Mustafizur Rahman digs it out.

OUT! RUN OUT! Bangladesh are falling apart! Another run out and Bangladesh are now 9 down! A shorter ball, on middle. Mahmudullah taps it on the leg side. He leaves the crease for a single, but he stops and sends his partner back mid-way. Mujeeb Ur Rahman runs to his right, collects the ball, and throws it directly at the non-striker's end. Shoriful Islam is well short of his crease and he walks back now!
Mustafizur Rahman is the last man in.
Shorter ball, outside off. Mahmudullah taps it to point.
Tadd shorter, around middle. Mahmudullah tucks it past square leg for a brace.
Full again, around middle. Shoriful Islam knocks it to long off for a single.
Swing and a miss! fuller ball, spinning away, outside off. Shoriful Islam swings his bat at it but misses.
Fuller ball, outside off. Shoriful Islam blocks it out.
An off-pace delivery, on a length, outside off. Shoriful Islam opens the face of the bat and guides it wide of third man for a single.
Fuller ball, on middle. Shoriful Islam backs away and taps it towards point.
FOUR! Edgy runs! Bangladesh will not mind that! On a length, outside off. Shoriful Islam leans and goes for the drive, but the ball goes off the outside edge past the keeper for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, on middle. Shoriful Islam backs away and pushes it back to the bowler.
Wide! Fazalhaq Farooqi drops it short now, around middle. Shoriful Islam ducks under it. Wide called!
Slower ball, on a length, around middle. Mahmudullah tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A fuller-length ball, outside off. Mahmudullah pushes it to the fielder at cover.
Fazalhaq Farooqi is back!
On middle, blocked out.
Flatter now, outside off. Mahmudullah dabs it towards point for a single.
Shorter ball, turning it in on middle. Mahmudullah tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Slower ball, around middle, fuller in length. Shoriful Islam manages to get an outside edge towards third man for a single.
Shorter ball now, around middle. Mahmudullah tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, spinning it in, on the pads. Mahmudullah misses his flick.
Shoriful Islam walks out to bat!

OUT! LBW! Bangladesh continue to tumble and it's Rashid Khan who does it once again in his final over of his spell! He comes in from 'round the wicket to the left-hander, serves a fuller ball, this one lands around middle and off and turns away. Taskin Ahmed leans to defend this, but gets beaten on the outside edge and gets rapped on his back pad. The umpire raises his finger immediately after the appeal. But Taskin Ahmed opts for a review. No bat involved, impact is umpire's call and wickets is hitting. The on-field decision stands.
Has Rashid got a wicket on the last ball of his spell? The umpire has given it out for LBW but Taskin reviews. Seems out.
Loopy ball, full and on middle. Taskin Ahmed leans and blocks it out.
BEAUTY! Much slower through the air now, full and outside off. Taskin Ahmed sweeps but gets beaten due to lack of pace.
A googly now, much fuller, on middle. Taskin Ahmed leans and blocks it out.
Shorter now, on the pads. Mahmudullah taps it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Slower through the air, outside off, on a fuller length. Mahmudullah drives and finds the fielder at cover.
Loopy ball, outside off. Taskin Ahmed pushes it to cover.
Fuller ball, on middle. Taskin Ahmed blocks it out.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh, dear! This was the last thing Bangladesh needed! Mehidy Hasan walks back early and Afghanistan are all over Bangladesh now! A fuller ball, turning it in on middle. Mehidy Hasan stays back and taps it towards mid-wicket and runs across to the other end for a single. But he is sent back by Mahmudullah, mid-wday. Najibullah Zadran is quick to collect the ball and throw it directly onto the stumps at the keeper's end. Mehidy Hasan dives but falls short of his ground. It was referred but just to be sure, Hasan knew he was a goner.
Run out appeal and it is taken upstairs. Mehidy Hasan seems well short.
Fuller length, around middle. Mahmudullah taps it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short in length, outside off. Mehidy Hasan stays in his crease, opens the face of his bat and guides it to third man for a single.
Tosses it up, full, on middle. Mahmudullah eases it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Another googly, round middle and leg. Mahmudullah works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, shorter. Mahmudullah cuts it towards point.

Wide! A shorter ball, googly now, down the leg side. Mahmudullah looks to pull this but misses. Rahmanullah Gurbaz thinks he has got some bat on it and appeals for caught behind but the umpire says no. Wide called!
Tosses it up, very full, on middle. Mahmudullah digs it out back to the bowler.
Slower through the air now, loopy ball, on middle. Mahmudullah defends it out.
Short again, around middle. Mehidy Hasan pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, quicker. Mahmudullah miscues his sweep towards short fine leg for a single.
Powerplay 3! Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the 50th over.
Another run! On middle, Mahmudullah strokes it down to long on and gets to the other end.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
A single this time as this is pushed past the bowler and down to long on.
Tossed up on off, defended.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to the right of the bowler.
The paddle scoop comes out, it goes towards fine leg for one.
Fuller and on off, Mehidy Hasan strokes it to mid off and takes one.
On off, defended.
On middle, Hasan works it to mid-wicket.
Shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
On off, Hasan pushes it through covers and gets to the other end.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Floats it up and on off, Mehidy Hasan defends it out.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Confusion but no harm done! Tossed up on off, Mehidy Hasan defends it towards cover and wants one but is sent back.
Mehidy Hasan walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Another one bites the dust and Nabi has two in two overs. This time it is the hero of the first game, Afif Hossain and Bangladesh are in big trouble now. Not sure if this was needed. This is slightly shorter and skids through on middle. Afif looks to pull, it hurries onto him. It goes off the splice and towards mid on. Mujeeb takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Mujeeb Ur Rahman b Mohammad Nabi

Commentary.Commentary: This time he flicks it away from the fielder in that region and takes one.
Tossed up on off, this is worked to square leg.
FOUR! Fails to close the over out and the last ball spoils it somewhat! Bowls this one short and outside off, Afif Hossain cuts it through point and it races away to the fence.
Outside off, this is guided to point. A warning for Mujeeb for stepping on the danger area. AN OFFICIAL WARNING!
On off, this is played back to the bowler.
Very full and on middle, this is jammed back to the bowler.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Drop and run! On off, this is pushed to covers for one.
A dot to end! On middle, defended. End of a wicket-taking over.
Afif Hossain comes to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Das goes 14 short of a ton. This is a massive wicket and a timely one. This stand was going along nicely and probably in an over or two, they would have stepped on the gas but Nabi has provided the breakthrough. He has been rewarded for his good bowling so far. He tosses this up and on off, Das looks to go over cow corner. There is extra bounce on this one. It goes off the top edge to the right of long on. Gulbadin Naib makes a lot of ground and then takes a tumbling catch. Brilliant from him too. Have to say Afghanistan are on top after this wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Gulbadin Naib b Mohammad Nabi

Commentary.Commentary: The sweep comes out, it is hit through square leg for one.
On middle, Das now flicks it through square leg and takes one.
Outside off, shorter, this is guided through point for one.
On middle, this is worked to square leg.
Six from the over then and the 150 is up! On middle, this is tucked around the corner for one.
On off, Das pushes it through covers and takes one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Angled into the pads, Das works it through mid-wicket for one.
Two more! Really good running! On off, this is pushed through covers for two.
That one stayed low! Shorter and on middle, Das makes room and looks to cut, he had to get his bat down in time though and does. It goes to mid off.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman (4-0-18-0) comes back into the attack.
Closes out the over well! Nabi has not got a wicket but is doing his job well especially with two right-handers out there. On off, Das pushes it through covers for one.
On middle, Das works it to mid-wicket.
Just the one! Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for one.
Another dot! Pushes this one through and on off, Mahmudullah strokes it to covers.
Floats it up on off, defended. Really good from Nabi. Keeping it tight.
Tossed up on off, blocked.
A dot to end another tidy over from Rashid! Fuller and on off, Das drives but finds cover.
On off, this is flicked through square leg for one.
Another one on the pads, this is flicked through square leg for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Slightly shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards wide mid on for one.
Shortish and around off, this is guided to point.

DRINKS! Liton Das is the only batter still standing tall at the crease, while the others have failed to stick around. Afghanistan have done well to grab wickets and keep the batters quiet. Bangladesh need a partnership from here to get them to a good total.
Fires this one in and on off, Mahmudullah guides it to the point fielder.
Clever batting! Mahmudllah gets low and plays the paddle scoop, over the keeper and towards fine leg for two.
Flatter and on off, Mahmudullah waits and then guides it to short third man.
Slightly shorter, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Mahmudullah comes down the track and works it towards square leg for one.
A single now! On middle, this is worked to the left of mid-wicket. Das wants one, Mahmudullah waits but then takes off. Comfortably makes it.

NOT OUT! Impact is outside off. That seemed the case throughout, not sure why Rashid was so keen on the review. They have lost one in the end. It is the googly, it lands outside off and spins back in. Mahmudullah looks to defend with a big stride forward but misses. It hits the pad. A huge appeal but turned down. Rashid wants the review and it is taken. Replays show that the on-field call was the right one.
Review! Afghanistan have reviewed an LBW decision against Mahmudullah. Not bat involved confirms, UltraEdge, and the impact is outside off stump, indicates Ball Tracker. Afghanistan lose a review.
Now follows the boundary with one as this is worked through square leg.
FOUR! Das looks to break the shackles and finds the fence. This is tossed up outside off, the slog sweep is out, it is hit through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Mahmudullah gets underway! Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Outside off, Das stays back and pushes it through covers for one.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
Shorter, on middle. Mahmudullah stays in his crease and defends it out.
Slower through teh air now, loopy ball, around off. Mahmudullah looks to defend this but does so with the inner half of the bat.
Tad fuller, outside off. Mahmudullah shuffles across and taps it to mid-wicket.
Turning it in, tad shorter. Mahmudullah works it towards square once again.
Outside off, tad fuller. Mahmudullah gets across and taps it to square leg.
A shorter ball, around middle. Liton Das flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Mahmudullah walks out to bat!

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! The magician has done the trick once again! Yasir Ali walks back to the hut now. Another fuller ball, turning it away once again. Yasir Ali fails to pick up the ball, he tries to push this away with tentative foot movement there and ends up getting a thick outside edge towards first slip. Gulbadin Naib there takes a good low catch towards his right. Rashid Khan gets two wickets in two overs! Replays actually show it hit the pad of Gurbaz and then lobbed up to the slip fielder. Afghanistan well and truly back into this one.
Commentary.Howout: c Gulbadin Naib b Rashid Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Slower through the air, full, around middle. Liton Das eases it down to long on for a single.
Quick again, around off. Liton Das defends it out.
Tuch quicker, outside off, full in length. Liton Das leans and pushes it towards cover. Another dot ball!
Loopy ball, fuller and around off. Liton Das defends it out.
Tad fuller, on the pads, quicker as well. Liton Das taps it to mid-wicket.
Short in length, around off. Liton Das knocks it down to long on for a single.
Fuller ball, drifting down the leg side. Yasir Ali works it away towards short fine leg for a single.
Flatter ball, darting it on the pads. Yasir Ali blocks it out.
Short again, outside off. Liton Das pushes this off the back foot past point for a single.
Shorter ball, this lands around off and turns in around middle. Liton Das punches this off the back foot to the fielder at cover.
Loopy ball, fuller in length, around middle. Liton Das works it away toward mid-wicket.
A googly now, shorter, around middle. Yasir Ali pushes it towards cover. Dot to end a successful over!
Yasir Ali walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The magician strikes and sends back Mushfiqur Rahim! A classical leg spinners' delivery here by Rashid Khan! A fuller ball, this one lands outside off, and turns away just a tad, forcing the batter to come forward on this. Mushfiqur Rahim does exactly that, he leans to block this but gets a slight outside edge back to the keeper. Rahmanullah Gurbaz takes a sharp catch. Bangladesh are now 3 down! Afghanistan crawling back into the game now.
Commentary.Howout: c Rahmanullah Gurbaz b Rashid Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Turning it in, on the pads. Liton Das taps it wide of short fine leg, the fielder there does well to stop the ball. Single taken!
Tad shorter, a googly, around middle. Liton Das pulls it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Quicker through the air now, full, on middle. Liton Das blocks it out.
Tossed up ball, full, on middle. Mushfiqur Rahim has swept this away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter again, on middle. Liton Das defends it out.
Darting it on the pads. Liton Das taps it to mid-wicket.
Flatter and shorter, outside off. Liton Das punches it past cover for a single.
Tad shorter now, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim pushes it past point for a single.
Tosses it up, on middle. Mushfiqur Rahim blocks it out.
Nabi begins with a loopy ball, turning it in around middle. Liton Das sweeps but gets a top edge towards fine leg for a single.
Shorter and quicker, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim punches it towards point.
Loopy ball, full again, on off. Liton Das knocks it down to towards long on for a single.
Very full, slower through the air, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim drives it past cover for a single.
Much fuller now, a googly, around middle. Mushfiqur Rahim taps it towards square leg.
Touch shorter, around middle. Liton Das works it away towards square leg for a single.
Tosses it up, full and on middle. Liton Das blocks it out.
Length ball, width on offer. Liton Das slashes it past point for a single.

In the air.. but safe! Shorter ball, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim tries to get on top of the bounce and tries to push this away, but the ball goes off the outside edge over the fielder at gully towards third man. Two taken!
Much fuller now, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim opens the face of the bat and drives it past cover for a brace.
This one lands on a length, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim cuts and finds the fielder at cover-point.
Short again, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim hops and blocks it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Liton Das strokes it past cover for a single.
Tad shorter, outside off. Liton Das pushes it past over for a single.

Flatter and shorter, around middle. Mushfiqur Rahim stays deep in his crease and taps it towards mid-wicket and scampers through to the other end. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Leg spinner now, full and around off. Mushfiqur Rahim leans and defends it out.
Shorter now, around middle. Liton Das pulls it to the fielder at mid-wicket, who fasl to stop the ball and the batters sneak in a run!
Tad quicker, turning it away, outside off. Liton Das taps it towards short third man.
Loopy ball, full on middle. Liton Das blocks it out.
Fuller now, around off. Mushfiqur Rahim drives it but finds the fielder at mid off. End of a successful over by Azmatullah Omarzai!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Mushfiqur Rahim leans and blocks it.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Azmatullah Omarzai strikes and gets rid of Shakib Al Hasan now. This is the second time in the series he has been dismissed like that, earlier was of a spinner! This one lands on a length, around middle. Shakib Al Hasan stays back and looks to block this, but he is late in his shot, and the ball goes off the inside edge and onto the stumps. Unlucky for Shakib Al Hasan, but Afghanistan have broken the partnership!
Azmatullah Omarzai drops it short again around middle. Liton Das pulls this past mid-wicket for a single.
Another short ball, on middle. Liton Das miscues his pull shot to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Back of a length, darting it on the thigh pads. Shakib Al Hasan looks to pull but ends up dragging it with the inner half of his bat towards square leg for a single.
Another shorter on, on middle. Shakib Al Hasan pulls it gently towards mid-wicket for a single. He will keep strike for the next over!
Fraction shorter, outside off. Liton Das stands tall and pushes it past point for a single.
Change of pace this time. Slower one, full in length, around off. Shakib Al Hasan pushes it towards long off for a single. 100 up for Bangladesh!
Pitches it up, on the pads. Shakib Al Hasan works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Another fuller ball, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan lifts it over cover. The ball won't go all the way to the fence but the batters pick up two runs!
FOUR! Crunched! Very full, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan drives it past cover for a cracking boundary. That brings up the 50-run stand between these two!
On middle, Das strokes it to mid on.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
FOUR! That is beautiful! He held the pose too. Yes, it is a half volley but still has to be put away. Fuller and on off, this is driven wonderfully through covers for a boundary.
Outside off, Shakib guides it down to third man for one.

Fifty for Das! His excellent form continues, follows a ton with his fifty and he is not done yet. Yet another opportunity for him to get a big one. He gets there by pushing this through covers for one.
On off, defended.
Angled into the pads, this is clipped through square leg for one.
That is a beauty! Fuller and outside off, Das looks to drive but this lands and then moves away. He is beaten.
Two more! Shorter and outside off, this is pushed wide of sweeper cover for a couple.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
A single as this is pushed through covers.
WIDE! This is very wide outside off, left alone.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
On off, Shakib opens the face of the bat and guides it to point.
Flatter and on middle, Shakib hangs back and defends.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
A single as this is eased down to long off.
Misfield and two! Poor effort. Shorter and on off, this is pushed towards cover. Najibullah Zadran lets it through, two taken.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Leading edge but safe! On off, angling away. Shakib closes the face of the bat early, it goes off the leading edge past point and down to third man for one.
Shorter and outside off, Shakib looks to cut but chops it to point.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Another one outside off, Shakib guides this down to third man for one.
Outside off, left alone.
Extra bounce! Shorter and outside off, Hasan looks to cut but this one takes off after landing. It goes past the outside edge.
A single to end! Shorter and on off, Hasan flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes one.
On middle, this is nudged on the leg side for a single.
On off, this is blocked.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On off, pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! That is a poor ball to begin with! Short and down the leg side, this is pulled fine on the leg side for a boundary.

DRINKS! It's been a positive start for Bangladesh. They are taking their own time to settle in, but are rotating well and making sure to keep the scoreboard ticking. While Afghanistan have done well to apply pressure but they need another wicket here to try and not let this pair get away with a big score. Also, Rashid Khan comes into the attack now.
Shorter and outside off, Shakib looks to push at it but is beaten.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Good length and on off, Das pushes it to covers yet agian.
Two more! Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for two.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
On off, Das pushes it to covers.
Angled into middle, Shakib keeps it out.
Outside off, Das guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Just over! Length and on off, Shakib looks to hit it over cover, it goes off the splice but over the fielder for one.
Outside off, Das guides it down to third man for one.
Good length and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Needless! On off, this is pushed to covers. The fielder for no reason, looks to throw it to the keeper, it is way above his head and goes down to fine leg for one.
On off, this is played to covers. A good start by Naib.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
That is another beauty! Sees Shakib come down the track and bowls it shorter and on off, this lands and then moves away. Shakib is beaten as he tries to defend.
BEATEN! Length and on off, angles it away from the off pole. Shakib has a feel for it but is beaten. Good use of the angle there.
Shorter and outside off, Das guides it down to third man and takes one.
Shorter in length and on off, Das guides it to point.
Fuller and on off, Shakib strokes it to covers.
Gulbadin Naib comes into the attack.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side, Shakib ducks under it. Wided.
Again, around off and on a length, this is pushed to covers.
Good length and on off, Shakib stands tall and pushes it to covers.
FOUR! Nice and fine! That is a gift for Shakib! On the pads, he works it fine and this one races away to the fence.
Good length and on off, defended.
That raced off the bat! Shorter and outside off, this is cut through point for one. Third man does well to get across and stop it.
A bye to end a successful over! Shorter and on the body, Das ducks under it. It lands just in front of the keeper who does not stop it cleanly and a run is taken.
Outside off, Shakib strokes it through covers and takes one.
Goes very full again and on off, this is played back to the bowler.
Review! Shakib Al Hasan has reviewed an LBW decision! The replays roll in. No bat involved confirms UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows it was pitching outside leg. The decision needs to be overturned.

NOT OUT! That is pitching outside leg. It always seemed that way. A good review from Shakib and he survives. This is full yet again and tailing back in. The line is a little too straight though. Shakib looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. A huge appeal. The umpire gives it a long thought and then raises the finger. Shakib reviews immediately and replays show that the on-field call has to be overturned.
FOUR! Off the mark in wonderful fashion! That is a half volley, full and outside off, Hasan leans into it and strokes it through covers. The fielder kind of misfields there and it races away.
Shakib Al Hasan walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! There is the opening wicket for Afghanistan and it is the big one of the Bangladesh skipper, Tamim Iqbal. For the third time in three games he has been dismissed to Fazalhaq Farooqi. This is a lovely delivery, it is full, almost a yorker length, starts outside off and shapes back in. Tamim is late in getting his bat down and the stumps are hit. Welcome wicket for Afghanistan.
Time for Powerplay 2! A maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
FOUR! Top shot! Short and wide of off. Liton Das stays in his crease and cuts it perfectly wide of third man for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Liton Das defends it out.
Tad fuller, outside off. Liton Das leaves it alone.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Liton Das leans and blocks it out.

Leg bye! A stifled appeal for LBW, but the umpire is unmoved! Another length ball, angling in on the pads. Tamim Iqbal misses his flick and gets hit high on the pads. The ball rolls towards short fine leg and the batters sneak in a run.
Azmatullah Omarzai starts with a length ball, darting it on the pads. Tamim Iqbal works it away towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Glorious! Fazalhaq Farooqi pitches this one up, outside off. Liton Das leans and drives it past cover for a beautiful boundary!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Liton Das does not fiddle with that one.
FOUR! Nicely done! Angling in on middle and leg, on a length. Liton Das uses his wrists and flicks it past square leg for a boundary.
Fazalhaq Farooqi serves a back-of-a-length delivery outside off, from 'round the wicket. Liton Das lets that go through.
Short of a length again, outside off, swinging away. Liton Das leaves it alone.
Back of a length, outside off. Liton Das stays in his crease and punches it past cover for a brace.
Drifting it down the leg side, tad shorter. Liton Das looks to push this behind the keeper, but he gets a slight inside edge towards fine leg. Single taken!
FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! Shorter ball, around middle. Liton Das rocks back and pulls it past mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
Shorter now, outside off, much quicker this time. Liton Das hangs back and pulls it to the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller ball, drifting it in on the pads. Tamim Iqbal leans and works it away past mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses this one up, on middle, full in length. Tamim Iqbal shows the full face of the bat and blocks it out.
Back of a length, around middle. Liton Das pulls it towards square leg for a single.
Full-length delivery, around middle. Liton Das taps it towards mid on and takes a single. He retains the strike!
More movement! Fuller length, swinging away, wide of off. Liton Das leans to drive this but fails to reach the ball.
Fazalhaq Farooqi drops it short now, swinging away, outside off. Liton Das leans back and lets that go through to the keeper.
Another outswinger, on a length, outside off. Liton Das shoulders his arms at it.
Fazalhaq Farooqi serves it on a length now, outside off. Liton Das presses forward and blocks it towards point.
Fraction shorter, shaping away from the right-hander, outside off. Liton Das leaves it alone.
Loopy ball, outside off. Tamim Iqbal defends it out.
Another back-of-a-length delivery, outside off, flatter one now. Tamim Iqbal looks to cut this away, but gets a bottom edge back onto the deck.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! Shorter ball, darting it on the pads. Tamim Iqbal stays in his crease and clips it past square leg for a boundary.
Slower through the air, on the pads, and full in length. Tamim Iqbal leans and flicks it to the short fine leg fielder.
Shorter ball, outside off. Liton Das hangs back and cuts it towards the fielder at point, who dives to his left and makes a good stop. Single taken!
Fuller now, around middle. Liton Das leans and taps it towards mid on.
Wide! Shorter ball, firing it down the leg side. Liton Das leaves it alone. Wide called!
Another yorker, on middle, at 137.3 clicks. Tamim Iqbal digs it out. Another good over for Afghanistan, just two runs off it!
Fraction shorter, shaping away outside off at 135.7 clicks. Tamim Iqbal lets that go through to the keeper.
Length delivery, outside off. Tamim Iqbal leans and pushes it towards cover.
Yorker-length delivery, outside off. Liton Das opens the face of the bat and squeezes it out towards third man and rotates the strike.
Very full on this occasion, around middle and off. Liton Das pushes it back to the bowler.
Back of a length, outside off, shaping awa. Liton Das offers no shot to that.
Wide! Fazalhaq Farooqi drops it short now, down the leg side. Liton Das leaves it alone. Wide called!
Shorter ball, turning it in, around middle and leg. Liton Das pushes it past square leg off the back foot for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off, full in length. Liton Das leans and drives it to the fielder at cover.
Drifting down leg, fuller again. Tamim Iqbal flicks it past square leg for a single.
On the pads, touch fuller. Tamim Iqbal leans and flicks it towards square leg.
Tad fuller now, slower through the air, around middle. Liton Das pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Shorter ball, outside off. Liton Das cuts it towards point.
Wide! Firing this down the leg side. Liton Das misses his flick. Wide called!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Tamim Iqbal leans and blocks it out.
Fuller now, outsidde off. Tamim Iqbal drives it towards cover.
On a length, outside off. Tamim Iqbal pushes it towards point.

NOT OUT! An appeal for LBW, but the umpire says no! Very full on this occasion, coming back in a tad on the pads. Liton Das looks to flick but misses. Afghanistan go for a review! The replays roll in and UltraEdge confirms a slight spike as the ball passes through the bat. The on-field decision stands. The ball deflects off his pads and rolls towards fine leg. Single taken as well!
An appeal for an LBW is turned down. Afghanistan review but it seems to be going down leg.
Well bowled! Back of a length, shaping away, outside off. Liton Das stays in his crease and looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a length, around middle. Liton Das taps it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Turning this one into the left-hander, fuller length, around off. Tamim Iqbal lunges and defends this one. 1 run off Mujeeb Ur Rahman's first over!
Full, down the leg side. Tamim Iqbal flicks it on the leg side.
Flatter, slower through the air, outside off, fuller ball. Tamim Iqbal leans and blocks it out.
Fuller ball, on the pads. Liton Das leans and works it away past square leg for a single.
This one turns away, outside off. Liton Das taps it towards cover.
Turning it in, tad shorter, around middle. Liton Das taps it to mid-wicket.
Touch fuller, nipping in, around middle. Tamim Iqbal pushes it past mid on for a brace. 4 runs off the first over!
Beaten! Good-length delivery, shaping away, outside off. Tamim Iqbal leans to block this but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Much fuller now, outside off. Liton Das opens the face of the bat and pushes it towards third man for a single. Liton Das is underway as well!
An inswinger, around middle, on a length. Tamim Iqbal taps it to mid-wicket for a single. Tamim Iqbal and Bangladesh are up and running!
Shout for LBW, but not given! Another length ball, shaping in, around middle. Tamim Iqbal looks to flick but misses and gets trapped on the pads. That was missing leg.
Fazalhaq Farooqi starts off with a length ball, nipping in a tad, outside off. Tamim Iqbal looks to defend but gets beaten.
We are set to begin! Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das are the openers for Bangladesh. Fazalhaq Farooqi has the first new ball in hand. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Athar Ali Khan is near the pitch. He says that this pitch has a lot of grass. It's quite dry and it is going to play in favour of the seamers, provided they bowl in the right areas. Adds that there will be movement and the bowlers should bowl straighter. States that the seamers will play a crucial role.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Riaz Hassan, Rahmat Shah, Hashmatullah Shahidi (C), Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi, Gulbadin Naib (In for Fareed Ahmad), Rashid Khan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Fazalhaq Farooqi, Azmatullah Omarzai.

Bangladesh (Unchanged Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Liton Das, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Yasir Ali, Mahmudullah, Afif Hossain, Mehidy Hasan, Taskin Ahmed, Shoriful Islam, Mustafizur Rahman.
TOSS - Bangladesh have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

Afghanistan are still to put their best foot forward in this series. They have a world-class spin attack who are capable of causing a lot of trouble to the batters. But it's their batting that has let them down in the previous two games. They will want to bat better this time and avoid a whitewash. Though they have lost the series, they can still grab 10 important points in the ICC Cricket World Cup Super League and end this series on a high. Still a lot to fight for and we can expect another cracker of a game. Who will come out on top? We will find out. Stay tuned for the toss and team news.

Bangladesh have been exceptional so far. They stood tall against the spin attack of Afghanistan in the first ODI and managed to clinch victory, and they also posted a high score in the previous game, and defended the target. We have witnessed different players stepping up on different occasions with the bat, and they will be hoping they do the same here. While their bowling department have been lethal so far as they managed to bundle out Afghanistan below 220 on both occasions. They will want to replicate the same and clean sweep Afghanistan.

Hello and a warm welcome to the third and the final ODI of this exciting series between Bangladesh and Afghanistan. The hosts have taken an unassailable 2-0 lead and have managed to seal the ODI series, and now they will eyeing to clean sweep the Afghans. While Afghanistan will look to end the ODI series on a positive note and grab 10 vital points in the ICC Cricket World Cup Super League.
